message: In the concealed twin Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) retrofit concept from Structural Dynamics Lead and Vibration Control Specialist, the under-deck support and finishes have visual intrusion and slip risk. To check it I used the under-deck twin-unit layout sketch (E7) and the concealed mounting detail sketch (E9) with the two-degree-of-freedom response simulation (E6). I found zero hardware above deck level with 20.0 millimetres damper travel housed below the soffit, according to Setra, 2006 and Den Hartog, 1947. I propose U-bolted transverse clamp beams to existing cross-girders, paired 250 kilogram units on coil springs with viscous dampers, soffit hatches and deck-matching paint. My position: ready because deck-view preservation and maintainable under-deck connection are shown with no change to deck sightlines.
